opening.text: I have pain that came on all of a sudden. It feels like pulling or tugging, and I'd rate it a 6 out of 10. I'm also quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I get palpitations where my heart races or beats irregularly, and I feel lightheaded, dizzy, or faint. I regularly take stimulant drugs.
